$Comment: Set of Plates: sit down to The Feast in several years, one Golden Plate each. The Feast comes back
once a year (Repeat.PerRun in Quests/SeasonsOfOrbis/_Harvest_Feast/The_Feast.json), so each year's
collect adds one, and the criterion's Amount is how many years it takes. The description's number
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table or season_keepsake tag, so
neither The Full Table nor the Seasons of Orbis ladder waits on it. It pays the title
Harvest_Feast_Marthas_Regular (Titles/SeasonsOfOrbis/) through the Title reward kind, on unlock,
and nothing else: the plates are its reward. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id
harvest_feast_set_of_plates, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
